resources.string: New: the phone vibrates with the truck (bumps, rough roads, collisions, the engine, the blinkers, gear shifts), each event in its own way, set up in the settings. Dashboard mode (chosen at the first start or in the settings): a tablet or a second phone shows the instruments beside the phone that drives. The rev counter is on top, the quick actions are arranged with the most needed ones first, and every press is answered. Update Truck Remote Server: it has a setup wizard, presses your own keys of the game and updates itself. Analog pedals (touch and drag up to press harder), throttle lock (turn it on in settings) and three pages of quick actions: truck (engine, trailer, wipers…), driving (retarder, engine brake, cruise speed, quick park) and view (cameras, map, dashboard, radio). Update Truck Remote Server on your PC to use them. Steering sensitivity is now set in the app with a live preview, the server can be found by its QR code. The steering uses the gyroscope together with the accelerometer and an adaptive filter: smooth, without a lag. Long press a quick action to put any other action in its place; the steering smoothness is set in the settings. On the dashboard: warnings (air, oil, overheating, fuel, wear, rest) and the distance and time to the destination; the panel shows the diff lock, the lift axle and the retarder level (update Truck Remote Server). Auto pause: the controls are released while the phone lies screen down. The cargo, destination and time left are shown during a job; the screen is dimmed while the controls are paused. Low fuel shows the range; speed units can be chosen in the settings; ETS2 and ATS can have separate steering, quick actions and units (the game is detected by itself).

This app is designed to be used as a steering wheel in some popular truck simulators like Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator.

Developer: Alex Churkin

Contact:
churkinapps@gmail.com

Icons, libraries and their licenses are listed in Settings → Third-party software and licenses.
Download Truck Remote Server and run it on the computer with the game: https://github.com/alexChurkin/TruckRemoteServer . It\'s a single file, and it updates itself.

On the first start its setup wizard installs everything the phone needs: the telemetry plugin of the game, the vJoy joystick driver and the firewall rule. The server shows its address and QR code: scan it in the app settings if the phone doesn\'t find the server. The server also sets up the controls of the game profiles: vJoy becomes their controller (Keyboard + vJoy Device), and the keys you have bound in the game keep working. Close the game once after its first start with a new profile, so the server can set it up.
Use the \"Simple Automatic\" transmission (gears can be shifted with the quick actions too) and set \"Steering sensitivity\" and \"Steering non-linearity\" as follows:

The phone vibrates with the truck: bumps, rough roads and rumble strips, collisions, the engine, the blinker relay and gear shifts, each with its own pattern (the phones with a precise vibration motor feel the most). This needs the telemetry plugin the server installs. Without it the phone vibrates on the force feedback of the game: then it is recommended to disable all types of feedback in the game, except for the Collisions (50%), Bumps (~15%) and Terrain (~10%).

Make sure that your phone or tablet is connected to the same network as the computer and start the app: it finds the server by itself, or you can set its IP address in the settings. Tilt the phone to steer: the sensitivity, the dead zone and the curve are set in Settings → Steering with a live preview.

Touch a pedal and drag up to press it harder, down to release it: the press force is shown over the pedals (keys can be used instead, see the settings). While holding the gas from 5%, swipe sideways to keep its level; touch a pedal to release it. Turn cruise control on by swiping up on the gas pedal, turn it off by swiping again or touching the brake.

The button at the bottom center opens the quick actions panel in place of the middle controls: the engine, the lights, the retarder, cameras, the map and much more, the most needed ones on the first page (swipe for the next ones). Long press a button to put another action in its place. Every press is answered: a button that springs reached the game, a button that shakes didn\'t.
The controls are released while the phone lies screen down or up, so the truck doesn\'t drive off when you put the phone on the table. It can be turned off in the settings.

A tablet or a second phone can show the instruments of the truck beside the phone that drives: choose Dashboard when the app asks how the device will be used at its first start (or later in Settings → Mode). It finds the server by itself.

The search goes on in the background. Please check that:

• Truck Remote Server is running on the PC
• the phone and the PC are connected to the same network (guest Wi-Fi networks often don't let devices see each other)
• the server is allowed in Windows Firewall (the server offers it on the first start)
• the port is the same in the app and in the server

You can also enter the server IP address (shown in the server window) in Settings.
